title: Stuck & Duck
description:
Stuck on something,
share it by adding to Stuck & Duck.
Either directly or via twitter
with #s&d! as a trendword.

Then perhaps rubberduck explain it
and perhaps you solve the problem yourself then.
Or find others with similar problems.
Or find links to external sites with similar problems.

And always enter solutions for future people stuck on the same or similar issue.
